style_ref.source: tools/garden-art/assets.json 의 style_ref 와 같은 도서관 홈페이지 화풍(STYLE·CLAY)
style_ref.STYLE: soft 3D clay pastel illustration, warm peach cream and soft sage palette, gentle rounded shapes, clean matte materials, soft natural daylight, rich fine detail, crisp edges, high quality
style_ref.CLAY: cute stylized 3D clay render, soft pastel peach cream and sage palette, matte clay texture, rounded simple shapes, miniature diorama feel, gentle warm daylight, soft shadows, clean and tidy, same style as a cozy pastel 3D illustration, highly detailed

sprite_suffix: isolated on a flat solid evenly lit pure white background, nothing else in the frame
chroma_suffix: the entire background is one solid flat vivid saturated neon magenta chroma-key background (#FF00FF), perfectly even, nothing else in the frame
chroma_suffix_black: the entire background is solid pure pitch black (#000000), perfectly even, no gradient, no vignette, no stars, no floor reflection, nothing else in the frame
notes: We Church 그림(2026-10-23). 만드는 법: GARDEN_ASSETS=tools/wechurch-art/assets.json python tools/garden-art/gen_garden_assets.py gen|pick|export
wc-world 는 하늘을 검정으로 그려 지운다 — 화면이 그 고장 지금 시각·날씨의 하늘을 뒤에 그린다(살아 있는 창과 같은 방식)
섬(ui) 그림은 흰 바탕 rembg, 실패하면 검정 크로마키로 다시
후보는 1장씩(교회PC 8GB 에서 한 장 6~7분). wc-icon 은 선택 항목(--optional)

assets.prompt: Cute stylized 3D clay render diorama, soft pastel colors, matte clay texture, rounded simple toy-like shapes, miniature, gentle soft light. Wide eye-level panoramic view of a peaceful small Korean countryside town, open outdoors only, no window, no frame. In the left foreground a cozy small cream house with a tidy front garden, a little garage and a small rounded mint car on the driveway. A gently winding road leads through the middle to a small white country church with a modest bell steeple and a simple cross, standing on a low green hill. Scattered small houses with gardens along little roads, patchwork green rice fields, round fluffy trees with dense rounded canopies. On the right a calm pastel blue sea bay with a tiny harbor. Layered rounded clay hills leading to distant soft clay mountains at the horizon. Summer: lush soft greens. The sky above the mountains is solid pure pitch black (#000000), perfectly even, no gradient, no vignette, no stars, no floor reflection, nothing else in the frame.
assets.post: 크로마키 대신 tools/wechurch-art/key_sky.py out/raw/wc-world_c2.png images/wechurch/world.webp --step 4 --w768 (하늘이 회녹색 그라데이션으로 그려져 색 키가 언덕을 먹음)
